observations.text: CompanyHouse explicitly lists the commercial register entry (Eintragung) for Rapid Resilience GmbH on 22 September 2026 and separately dates the articles of association to 27 July 2026.

observations.subject: Jan Boeckmann
observations.text: TUM identifies Boeckmann as the founder and describes his doctoral research on siting flood-mitigation measures.
TUM reports that interviews with municipalities identified a gap in access to heavy-rain risk tools.
TUM describes a research-validated prototype for rain-hazard mapping.
The team describes moving from a working forecasting prototype to a platform for multiple clients.
The team reports offering transparent pilots and backtesting to SME prospects. Pilot completion and revenue need verification.

observations.subject: Amir Mabhout
observations.text: TU Berlin lists the CEO's doctorate in mixed-signal circuit design, the team's first product domain.

observations.subject: Amir Mabhout
observations.text: The company credits Mabhout with production analog and mixed-signal tape-outs, including Ethernet PHY and energy-harvesting designs.

observations.subject: Amir Mabhout
observations.text: The company credits Mabhout with five first-author IEEE papers. The publication list needs independent corroboration.

observations.subject: Holger Niessner
observations.text: The company reports that Niessner founded and sold Tacit and led data science and full-stack teams.

observations.subject: Amir Mabhout and Holger Niessner
observations.text: The team page documents circuit-design execution by Mabhout and engineering-team leadership by Niessner.
The TU Berlin profile describes days of manual setup between a specification and a working circuit simulation.
The profile describes agents operating existing EDA tools, with solver checks and a trace of each step. Comparative performance remains unverified.
The company publishes demos of its verification and characterization workflows.
The company offers early access for design partners and a walkthrough on prospective users' circuits.
The public register listing gives 28 April 2026 as Jouly GmbH's founding/registration date, HRB 286719.
